create_STSP_instance: create an STSP instance with a given dimension for the stochastic traveling salesman problem
create_STSP_complex: create an STSP instance with complex_tsp enabled to add order penalty to the objective
simulate_STSP: simulate the stochastic TSP by calling _simulate_stsp with a numpy array to get total tour distance
make_STSP_plots: make a plot of the STSP optimization run and save it to a PNG file
review_STSP_class: review the STSP class which extends ExperimentFunction for stochastic traveling salesman problem benchmarking
